name: input_reference_mask_v20
method: Reasoning-driven direct weight-space programming without training
hypothesis: The input atom encoder mixes atoms from multiple reference spaces inside attention windows. Its learned same-reference mask distinguishes atoms of one ligand or one protein residue. Double this existing mask embedding to test whether a stronger indication of shared reference space helps the encoder combine local vectors into a handedness signal. Scaling an embedding does not guarantee a uniform increase in attention, so the effect remains empirical.
